subject: general
question: Who founded the International Olympic Committee (IOC) in 1894?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Baron Pierre de Coubertin**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Baron Pierre de Coubertin** founded the International Olympic Committee (IOC) in 1894.
 
• The IOC is the supreme authority of the worldwide Olympic movement.
 
• It was created to revive the ancient Olympic Games and to promote friendship and cooperation among nations through sports.
 
• Baron Pierre de Coubertin is often referred to as the father of the modern Olympic Games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first modern Olympic Games were held in Athens, Greece, in 1896.
 
• The Olympic Games are held every four years, with the Summer and Winter Games alternating every two years.
 
• The IOC is headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland.
 
• The Olympic motto is "Citius, Altius, Fortius," which means "Faster, Higher, Stronger."
 
• The Olympic symbol consists of five interlocking rings, representing the five continents of the world united by Olympism.
 
• The Olympic Charter is the codification of the fundamental principles of Olympism, rules, and bylaws adopted by the IOC.
